quests.instruction: Which kind of floor is usually the most slippery when wet?
quests.correctAnswer: Smooth tile 🧱
options: Smooth tile 🧱
Thick carpet 🧶
A rough doormat 🚪
quests.hint: Ask yourself which surface your shoes can grip.
quests.explanation: Smooth surfaces like tile and polished wood have little grip, so water makes them very slippery. Carpets and rough mats hold on to feet.
quests.funFact: Tiles with a rough texture are often chosen for bathrooms and entrances, because they grip better.

quests.instruction: A bright sign near a floor says 'wet floor'. What does it tell you?
quests.correctAnswer: Walk carefully or go around ⚠️
options: Run across it as quickly as you can 🏃
It is a fun slide you can try out 🛝
Walk carefully or go around ⚠️
quests.hint: Signs like this are there to prevent falls.
quests.explanation: A wet-floor sign warns that the surface is slippery. Walking slowly or choosing another route avoids a fall.
quests.funFact: Yellow is used for many warning signs because it is easy to see.

quests.instruction: You notice a shiny, slippery patch on the floor and do not know what made it. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Walk around it, tell a grown-up 🚶
options: Walk around it, tell a grown-up 🚶
Test it with your foot first 🦶
Ignore it and carry on playing 🙈
quests.hint: Do not step on something you cannot explain.
quests.explanation: A slippery patch could cause a fall for you or someone else. Going around it and telling an adult gets it cleaned.
quests.funFact: Oil, soap, and water can all make floors slick, and sometimes they look just like clean floor.

quests.instruction: Which of these can still be very hot even though it does not look hot?
quests.correctAnswer: A pan just taken off the stove 🍳
options: A cold glass of milk 🥛
A pan just taken off the stove 🍳
A paper kitchen towel roll 🧻
quests.hint: Heat is invisible, and metal holds it for a long time.
quests.explanation: A pan can stay hot for many minutes after it leaves the heat. You cannot tell by looking, so you stay back and leave it to adults.
quests.funFact: Some stoves have a small light that stays on until the hotplate has cooled down.

quests.instruction: A candle is burning on a table. What should a child do?
quests.correctAnswer: Leave it to a grown-up 🕯️
options: Blow on it from very close up 💨
Carry it to another room 🚶
Leave it to a grown-up 🕯️
quests.hint: Flames are not something children handle.
quests.explanation: Candles are lit and put out by adults. Papers, curtains, and sleeves near a flame can catch fire quickly.
quests.funFact: A candle flame can reach a temperature of more than a thousand degrees Celsius.

quests.instruction: A cup of hot tea sits at the very edge of the table. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell a grown-up, do not touch 🙋
options: Carry it to the sofa for them 🛋️
Tell a grown-up, do not touch 🙋
Push it back with your hand ✋
quests.hint: A hot drink spilled on skin causes a serious burn.
quests.explanation: A grown-up can move the cup safely. Carrying or pushing it risks a spill that could scald you.
quests.funFact: A hot drink can burn skin badly in just a few seconds.

quests.instruction: A razor is on the bathroom shelf. Who is allowed to use it?
quests.correctAnswer: Only a grown-up 🪒
options: Any child who is careful 🧒
Only a grown-up 🪒
Anyone with a bandage ready 🩹
quests.hint: Some tools are not made for children, no matter how careful.
quests.explanation: A razor is very sharp and made for adult use. Even careful children can cut themselves badly.
quests.funFact: Razor blades are among the sharpest things found in a home.

quests.instruction: You see a pin lying on the floor. What is the safest choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask a grown-up to pick it up 📌
options: Ask a grown-up to pick it up 📌
Pick it up with bare fingers ✋
Kick it under the sofa 🦶
quests.hint: A tiny sharp thing can still hurt, and it can be stepped on.
quests.explanation: A grown-up can pick it up safely and put it away. Kicking it away leaves it for someone to find.
quests.funFact: A small magnet is a quick way for an adult to pick up lost pins.

quests.instruction: Why is a toolbox usually kept closed and out of reach of young children?
quests.correctAnswer: The tools could hurt small hands 🧰
options: The tools could hurt small hands 🧰
The tools might rust in the light ☀️
The box is too heavy to see ⚖️
quests.hint: Think about saws, blades, and hammers.
quests.explanation: Tools like saws, screwdrivers, and hammers can cut, poke, or crush. Putting them away keeps small hands safe.
quests.funFact: A toolbox with a latch helps keep sharp tools from falling out.

quests.instruction: Why should you never put anything into a wall socket?
quests.correctAnswer: Electricity can hurt you badly ⚡
options: The socket might get very dusty 🌫️
The wall might get a bit warm 🧱
Electricity can hurt you badly ⚡
quests.hint: A socket is connected to a very strong source of power.
quests.explanation: Sockets carry electricity that can burn or shock. Only plugs made for them go in, and only when a grown-up decides.
quests.funFact: Many sockets have safety shutters that block objects that are not plugs.

quests.instruction: How is a plug removed from a socket safely, by a grown-up?
quests.correctAnswer: By gripping the plug itself 🔌
options: By yanking on the cord hard 💪
By gripping the plug itself 🔌
By pulling the wire and the plug 🧵
quests.hint: Pulling on a cord can damage the wires inside.
quests.explanation: Holding the plug and pulling straight out protects the cord. Yanking on the wire can break it and cause damage.
quests.funFact: A plug that is hot to touch is a warning sign to ask a grown-up to check.

quests.instruction: What is the risk when too many plugs are squeezed into one extension block?
quests.correctAnswer: It can overheat 🔥
options: It will make the lights dimmer 💡
It can overheat 🔥
It will get lighter in weight ⚖️
quests.hint: Each plug draws power through the same wire.
quests.explanation: Many devices on one block can draw more power than the wires can handle. That heat can start a fire.
quests.funFact: An extension block with a built-in switch can shut off when it overloads.

quests.instruction: A snack is on a very high shelf. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask a grown-up to get it 🧑
options: Pull out drawers to climb 🗄️
Stack chairs into a tower 🪑
Ask a grown-up to get it 🧑
quests.hint: Use your voice instead of your feet.
quests.explanation: A grown-up can reach it safely. Climbing drawers or stacked chairs can tip and cause a bad fall.
quests.funFact: Falls from furniture are one of the most common ways for young children to get hurt at home.

quests.instruction: Why is climbing on a tall bookcase dangerous?
quests.correctAnswer: It can tip over onto you 📚
options: The books might get bent 📖
It can tip over onto you 📚
The wood will lose color 🎨
quests.hint: Tall furniture can be top-heavy.
quests.explanation: A bookcase can topple if someone climbs it. That is why grown-ups often fasten tall furniture to the wall.
quests.funFact: Wall straps hold tall furniture in place so it cannot tip.

quests.instruction: When is it all right to use a step stool?
quests.correctAnswer: When it is steady, with permission 🪜
options: On top of a table to reach higher 🍽️
When no adult is around to check 👀
When it is steady, with permission 🪜
quests.hint: A tool for reaching still needs a safe setup.
quests.explanation: A steady step stool on the floor, with permission, is safe. Standing on a table or using it alone raises the chance of a fall.
quests.funFact: Some step stools fold flat so they can be tucked away when not in use.

quests.instruction: Why must the path to the front door stay clear?
quests.correctAnswer: So everyone can leave quickly 🚪
options: So everyone can leave quickly 🚪
So the doormat can still be seen 🧽
So the hall looks much bigger 🏠
quests.hint: Think about what you would need if you had to leave in a hurry.
quests.explanation: In an emergency, such as a fire, people need an open path out. Boxes and furniture in the way waste precious time.
quests.funFact: Fire safety guides say to keep doors and exits free of clutter.

quests.instruction: Which of these should NOT be placed in front of an exit door?
quests.correctAnswer: A large bookcase 📚
options: A large bookcase 📚
A thin doormat 🚪
A tiny plant pot 🪴
quests.hint: Choose the thing that would be hard to move in a hurry.
quests.explanation: A large bookcase would block the way and be hard to shift. A flat mat does not stop anyone from getting out.
quests.funFact: Exit paths should be wide enough for two people to walk side by side.

quests.instruction: A grandparent who uses a walking frame is coming to visit. What helps most?
quests.correctAnswer: Keep walkways wide and clear 🦯
options: Add more small rugs everywhere 🧶
Move some boxes into the hallway 📦
Keep walkways wide and clear 🦯
quests.hint: A frame needs more space than feet do.
quests.explanation: Wide, clear paths give room for a frame or a cane. Extra rugs and boxes make tripping more likely.
quests.funFact: Good lighting along walkways also helps people see where they are going.

quests.instruction: You find a colorful pill on the floor. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Do not touch it, tell an adult 💊
options: Do not touch it, tell an adult 💊
Taste it to see what it is 👅
Give it to the family pet 🐈
quests.hint: Pills can look like candy, and they are not.
quests.explanation: A pill left on the floor could be dangerous, and you cannot tell what it is. Leave it and let an adult deal with it.
quests.funFact: Many countries have a poison helpline that adults can call for advice.

quests.instruction: Red berries on a garden plant look tasty. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask a grown-up first 🫐
options: Ask a grown-up first 🫐
Eat one just to test it 🍒
Wash it and then taste it 🚿
quests.hint: Not everything that grows is good to eat.
quests.explanation: Some wild berries and plants are poisonous even if they look like safe fruit. Only eat food a grown-up has said is safe.
quests.funFact: Some plants that look like pretty decorations can also make people unwell if eaten.

quests.instruction: Why should you never mix different cleaning products?
quests.correctAnswer: They can make harmful fumes 🧪
options: They turn the floor sticky 🧴
They stop working altogether 🧽
They can make harmful fumes 🧪
quests.hint: Chemicals can react when they meet.
quests.explanation: Some cleaning chemicals produce poisonous gas when mixed. Adults read labels and use one product at a time.
quests.funFact: Fresh air and an open window are important when anyone uses strong cleaning products.

quests.instruction: Why must small flat button batteries be kept away from little children?
quests.correctAnswer: Swallowed, they can cause serious harm 🔋
options: They might quickly run out of power 🪫
Swallowed, they can cause serious harm 🔋
They are too shiny for small hands ✨
quests.hint: Think about what could happen if one went into a mouth.
quests.explanation: A swallowed button battery can burn the body from the inside in just a few hours. A child who swallows one needs a doctor at once.
quests.funFact: Many remote controls and toys hide button batteries behind a screw-down cover.

quests.instruction: Why should children not play with plastic bags?
quests.correctAnswer: They can block breathing 🛍️
options: They can block breathing 🛍️
They tear very easily when pulled ✂️
They make a lot of annoying noise 🔊
quests.hint: Plastic clings to skin and blocks air.
quests.explanation: A thin plastic bag over the face can stop breathing. Bags are kept away from small children.
quests.funFact: Many plastic bags carry a warning label for this reason.

quests.instruction: You find a lighter on the living-room table. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Leave it, tell a grown-up 🔥
options: Click it to see the flame 🕯️
Leave it, tell a grown-up 🔥
Hide it in your pocket 👖
quests.hint: A flame-maker is not a toy.
quests.explanation: Lighters and matches start fires, so they are for adults only. Telling a grown-up helps put it somewhere safe.
quests.funFact: Child-resistant lighters exist, but children can still work them out.

quests.instruction: Which of these is a good reason to ask an adult for help?
quests.correctAnswer: You are unsure it is safe 🗣️
options: You want to look very clever 🧠
You are bored and want a game 🎲
You are unsure it is safe 🗣️
quests.hint: Asking is the smart way to be safe.
quests.explanation: When you are not sure whether something is safe, asking is wise. Adults would much rather answer a question than treat an injury.
quests.funFact: Asking for help is something both children and adults do every day.

quests.instruction: Who counts as a trusted adult?
quests.correctAnswer: A grown-up who looks after you 🧑
options: Anyone who offers you sweets 🍬
A grown-up who looks after you 🧑
A stranger who seems friendly 😊
quests.hint: Trust grows with time and a link to your family.
quests.explanation: A trusted adult is someone your family knows and trusts, like a parent, grandparent, teacher, or neighbor. Strangers do not count, however friendly.
quests.funFact: Agreeing on a few trusted adults ahead of time tells children exactly who to turn to.

quests.instruction: Something dangerous is happening and you need help fast. How should you ask?
quests.correctAnswer: Say what is wrong and where 📢
options: Whisper and wait for someone 🤫
Send a message later on today 📱
Say what is wrong and where 📢
quests.hint: Clear words can be understood quickly.
quests.explanation: Saying what is wrong and where lets an adult act right away. Whispering or waiting wastes valuable time.
quests.funFact: Many emergency services teach children to say their name and address.

quests.instruction: A toddler is visiting. Which of these in a bedroom is the biggest hazard?
quests.correctAnswer: A heavy lamp on a wobbly shelf 💡
options: A soft rug on the bedroom floor 🧶
A closed wardrobe door with a latch 🗄️
A heavy lamp on a wobbly shelf 💡
quests.hint: Look for something that could fall onto a small person.
quests.explanation: A toddler could pull the shelf and bring a heavy lamp down. Rugs and closed doors are far less likely to hurt.
quests.funFact: A helpful trick is to look at a room from a child's height.

quests.instruction: Where is the safest place to play with toys while a grown-up cooks?
quests.correctAnswer: In a clear space, away from the stove 🧸
options: In a clear space, away from the stove 🧸
Right beside the hot oven door 🔥
On the stairs just by the kitchen 🪜
quests.hint: Choose a spot away from heat and from falls.
quests.explanation: A clear area away from heat, stairs, and moving adults keeps playtime safe. The oven and stairs are risky spots.
quests.funFact: Some kitchens have a gate or a rug to mark where children can play.

quests.instruction: Which sentence is the best safety rule for any room?
quests.correctAnswer: If you are unsure, stop and ask ✋
options: If it looks interesting, touch it 🖐️
If you are unsure, stop and ask ✋
If nobody is looking, try it 👀
quests.hint: A good rule works in every room and every time.
quests.explanation: Stopping to ask whenever something is unfamiliar prevents injuries before they happen. Curiosity is great, as long as it comes with a question.
quests.funFact: Even experts check with someone when they are not sure how something works.
